name: diff-block
title: Diff Block
description: A unified diff, as git or diff -u writes it, in code blocks: one for each file, its icon, name (both, renamed or copied) and what it adds and removes (+3 −1, small, in the faintest grey) in the header, each line with its number in a gutter (a removed line's in the old file; or old and new, `numbers="both"`) and its sign in a column of its own, hunks under their @@ line as a band between rules where a file has more than one; added and removed lines in the code block's greys; a binary file says so. parseUnifiedDiff reads the text into files, hunks and lines (their numbers, renames, copies, modes, binary files and the no-newline marker); the block takes the text or what it read. With `lines`, each file longer than that folds in its own block (CodeBlock's `lines`, its words in `labels`), only the lines it shows rendered while folded. DiffFileContent is a file's lines alone, e.g. in a viewer; its touch option hides numbers and hunk headers on coarse pointers, leaving signs alone. labels.unified names the unified view. DiffFileList lists the files a diff changes (an M, A or D, the path with its directory fainter, +n −n) to pick one, as a panel's list or in DiffFilesCard, a message's card of a turn's changes ("3 files changed +18 −3" and the app's action, e.g. Review all).
